newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,706 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,706 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 3,706 contracts compared with 951 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 442 wheat, 1,645 corn, 1,320 soybean, 49 soymeal, 161 soyoil, three oat, five corn calls, 70 soybean calls and 11 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to two cents lower, corn was 1/2 to 1-3/4 cents lower and soybeans were 1/2 to 3-1/2 cents lower.
